explanation: The theorem says that the library's own scalar-extension map on `KTheory.ProjectiveClass` (a K₀-type group of finitely generated projective modules) respects composition of ring maps. I grepped Mathlib for `ProjectiveClass`, `K₀` and `KZero`. Every hit is an unrelated use of the symbol K₀ (compact sets, valuations and similar). I found no Mathlib definition of the K₀ group of projective modules or of its functoriality. The mathematical content rests on the library's own definitions (`map`, `of`, `addHom_ext`) and on `ModuleCat.RightExtension.compLinearEquiv`, so no Mathlib declaration states this result.
